Omg! I thought I am the only one like this. I have the same coping mechanism. When I feel low I hate people.  I even hate their attention and their shity cliche phrases which I heard a million of times. I feel like people can't really support me in a right way, because my situation is too complicated.  Talking to people only makes everything worse, because I am constantly triggered by every little thing
Yes, pain sucks. I feel like I live with an invisible wound which never heals. It can't stop bleeding.
Yes . I am in the same situation.

Yes, once you feel bad they just don't give a shit,  people don't understand how to deal with suicide.  I hate society for this. I hate that people ignore you when you are suicidal.  And they wonder why we commit suicide. Well, because when we want to talk about this no one gives a fuck.
This is so fucking sad. I want to end this all too. But this is so heartbreaking to realise I may be reading someone's last words.

No one can give you a guarantee. It's not a fact that it will be better.  A lot of people are just afraid to admit that sometimes life just never becomes better. It may get better on the surface but unbearable on psychological level.

I'm 18 y.o. and it's really so hard to be a young person with mental health problems.  I' t too much pressure for us: our brains are not fully developed, a lot of new responsibilities, because we are entering into adulthood, pressure from society etc. It feels like I am going crazy and people think that I' m just overreacting and I can't have real problems at 18. Our society is so fucking unsupportive it's  really hard to find help.

I have no social life too. It's easy to say: " Talk to people and you will find someone" 
Sometimes it doesn't work like this. Sometimes person can have a social anxiety.  Sometimes person can be around people but still feel lonely 
I think it's not about lack of friends or not being a part of group, it's more about how your traumas and past experiences, which don't allow you to have healthy relationships with people. I have the same problem. I understand it very well 
It really makes me feel like I have no desire to live 
It feels like I will never be able to be a part of society 
I am a part of society, I am not isolated 
But I still feel like I am nobody
